actionbar.pneumaticdiversityvents.impell: Impeller mode: powered on / unpowered off
actionbar.pneumaticdiversityvents.termin: Terminal mode: standard / no indicator lights
actionbar.pneumaticdiversityvents.juncti: Junction fixed side: positive straight face
Junction fixed side: negative straight face
tooltip.pneumaticdiversityvents.vent_seg: Transparent modular tube. Shift-place on a two-long section to bend or reroute it.
Use the Portal wrench and look at powered venting to inspect airflow.
tooltip.pneumaticdiversityvents.vent_imp: Adds airflow to its connected vent network. Wrench-click reverses its configured polarity.
Adjacent antline indicators enable powered test-element modes.
tooltip.pneumaticdiversityvents.vent_ter: Focused open endpoint with a narrower, stronger and longer-reaching external force cone.
tooltip.pneumaticdiversityvents.vent_enc: One-long full-shell vent with the same internal opening and transport behavior as normal venting.
tooltip.pneumaticdiversityvents.vent_sca: Pulses connected antlines when its configured target crosses the scanner.
Wrench-click switches between PortalMod cubes and players.
tooltip.pneumaticdiversityvents.vent_jun: Powered two-route T-junction. It is always represented as one two-ended edge; no real graph split is created.
Wrench-click changes the fixed straight side. Crouch-wrench changes the unpowered default route.
Shift-place onto an unused side face to aim the alternate outlet.
advancement.pneumaticdiversityvents.too_: Reach maximum airflow speed while traveling through a Diversity Vent.
advancement.pneumaticdiversityvents.dont: Die from fall damage after being launched from a Diversity Vent without breaking the fall.
